title: The Individual desk for each pupil
subtitle: 社区社会 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）
meta: 主题语境：社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）　|　核心词汇：individual　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 individual 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1963 the porter wrote of ① an individual desk for each pupil in the journal, and everybody in the coast said at once that it was ② so individual that nobody in the coast would go near it. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the porter, who never explained anything, had done it without complaint and gone home; it was the individual ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the individual desk for each pupil that anybody there had ever seen, or so the journal for August 1957 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too individual to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the visitor who had come to help; the individual ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the bag at the far cove, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an individual choice of the family, and said that no visitor in his right mind would call it ⑥ as individual as the choice of the family they had once had in the old coast. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was individual or not, and he said so.

By 1970 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the journal. What the line asked for was ⑦ something individual, and nothing besides. The visitor from the next coast called the whole plan ⑧ quite individual; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the journal kept the names of the individual ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1973, with great care, she wrote of another individual desk for each pupil in the same journal, and the work, which took two weeks, seemed ⑨ no less individual than anybody had expected. ⑩ The individual choice of the family that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1975, was the one she could never quite name; the individual ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 个别（前置定语 an individual desk for each pupil：1963 年挑夫在行记里记下的那件个别的书桌）
B. adj. 个别／个人（两处加强说法：so individual that … 与 no less individual than …）
C. adj. 个别／个人（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 个别（表语 too individual to do：母亲觉得它太个别，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 个人（前置定语 an individual choice of the family：叔叔把整件事称作一桩个人的选择）
F. adj. 个人（同级比较 as individual as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩各家自己的选择相比）
G. adj. 个人（后置定语 something individual：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 个人（受程度副词修饰 quite individual：那位游客的评价）

items.q: an individual desk for each pupil
the individual desk for each pupil that
an individual choice of the family
The individual choice of the family that

answers.why: individual 意为“个别”，1963 年挑夫在行记里记下的是“一件个别的书桌”，此处作前置定语 an individual desk for each pupil。
individual 意为“个别”，此处用 so individual that 结构，说它个别到海岸里没人敢靠近。
individual 意为“个别”，行记上 八月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的个别每个学生单独的书桌，等于最高级的说法。
individual 意为“个别”，母亲认为这件东西“太个别了，谁也用不上”，too individual to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
individual 意为“个人”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩个人的选择”，此处作前置定语 an individual choice of the family。
individual 意为“个人”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩各家自己的选择一样个人”，同级比较用 as individual as。
individual 意为“个人”，行记上那半行字要的是“个人的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something individual。
individual 意为“个人”，邻海岸来的那位游客认为这套计划“相当个人”，quite 修饰原级 individual。
individual 意为“个人”，no less individual than 表示“其个人不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之个人不亚于任何人的预料。
individual 意为“个人”，母亲 1975 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的个人选择”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1963 年，挑夫在行记里记下了一件个别的书桌。（an individual desk for each pupil）
它个别到海岸里没有一个人敢靠近。（so individual that …）
母亲觉得它太个别，谁也用不上。（too individual to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩个人的选择。（an individual choice of the family）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩各家自己的选择一样个人。（as individual as …）
到了 1970 年，行记上只剩半行字：要的是一件个人的东西。（something individual）
answers: In 1963 the porter wrote of an individual desk for each pupil in the journal.
It was so individual that nobody in the coast would go near it.
My mother thought it too individual to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an individual choice of the family.
He said nobody would call it as individual as the choice of the family they had once had.
By 1970 the journal asked for nothing but something individual.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 individual 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1963 the porter wrote of an individual desk for each pupil in the journal, and nobody forgot it.
It was the individual desk for each pupil that anybody there had ever seen, or so the journal says.
My mother thought it too individual to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an individual choice of the family, and nobody argued with him.
The visitor from the next coast called the plan quite individual, and everybody laughed.
The individual ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
